name: Cloudy with a Chance of Latency

mentions.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Latency
mentions.description: Network monitoring tool that uses distributed probes reporting to central servers, with latency annotations tied to BGP events, IPv6 support, and TLS encryption for all probe-to-server communication. A landing-page website was recently added and the project is preparing to open for beta testers.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Still working on my network monitoring tool.

Since last time, added a "landing-page" kind of website [0], added annotations with BGP events, support for IPv6, and finishing TLS for every communication between probes and central servers.
